test_title: RRB NTPC - UG 2025 (CBT 1): Morning Practice - Day 1
subject: general
question: In which place in India, British started the "Dual system of Government''?
solution:
The correct answer is Option(4) i.e. __**Bengal**__

 
• The **British started the"Dual System of Government" in Bengal**.
 
• The company acquired **both Diwani and Nizamat rights** from the **Nizam-ud-Daulah.**
 
• Dual System of Government :
 
 
• A **dual system **is a form of governance **followed by the British in India after the battle of Plassey.**
 
• In this system, the **power is divided into two parts: the administrative power, and the revenue collection power**. While the former is given to the native rulers, the British have taken charge of the latter.
 
• Dual Government in Bengal was **introduced by Robert Clive in 1765 and continued till 1772**.
 
• Under this system, the **administration of Bengal was divided into** **two parts- Diwani and Nizamat**.
 
• **Diwani means the right to collect revenue was given to the company.**
 
• **Nizamat means administrative rights were given to nawab. **
 
• **T**he Nawab and his officials had the **responsibility of administration** but **not the power to discharge it.**
 
• The Dual system of Government **was abolished by Warren Hastings in 1772** and Bengal was brought under the direct control of the British. The Nawabs remained as the mere pensioners of the East India Company.
